<thought>We need to determine how many methyl (CH₃) groups are present in the unknown molecule. The available tools can provide NMR spectra for the sample at hand. By retrieving the 13C NMR spectrum, we can count the number of distinct carbon signals in the typical methyl region (≈10–30 ppm). Each distinct methyl carbon will correspond to one CH₃ group. Therefore, we will request the 13C NMR data.</thought>
